title: Aborted streaming responses discard already-received usageMetadata

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a bug where usage metadata from aborted streaming responses is discarded. It provides specific file references (packages/core/src/core/turn.ts and loggingContentGenerator.ts), test references (turn.test.ts), expected vs actual behavior, and technical details to fix or reproduce.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Modifying asynchronous response stream handling and telemetry error logging across turn.ts and loggingContentGenerator.ts to capture partial token usage upon stream cancellation requires updating async generators, event structures, and error-handling blocks.

summary.problem: When a streaming response is aborted (via Ctrl-C, timeout, or signal abort), already-received usageMetadata is discarded instead of being logged or emitted.
summary.root_cause: In Turn.run (packages/core/src/core/turn.ts), stream cancellation returns or yields UserCancelled before emitting a Finished event, dropping accumulated usageMetadata. In LoggingContentGenerator (packages/core/src/core/loggingContentGenerator.ts), lastUsageMetadata is captured per-chunk but only flushed via _logApiResponse on stream completion, skipping telemetry recording in the catch block for AbortError.
summary.context: Telemetry, logging, and token usage tracking depend on logging wrappers and event emissions. Discarding usage metadata on aborted turns prevents accurate token billing and telemetry reporting for partial generations.

steps: In packages/core/src/core/loggingContentGenerator.ts, update loggingStreamWrapper to handle stream abortion in the catch block by logging lastUsageMetadata if present before rethrowing.
In packages/core/src/core/turn.ts, track lastUsageMetadata from streamed chunks during iteration.
In packages/core/src/core/turn.ts, update UserCancelled event or cancellation handling to retain and emit the captured usageMetadata when signal?.aborted is triggered.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a stream is aborted after receiving content chunks with usageMetadata, the usage metadata received prior to cancellation is retained and reported.
verification_steps: In packages/core/src/core/turn.test.ts, add or update a test where stream chunks contain usageMetadata before an abort signal is triggered.
Assert that stream cancellation preserves and yields or logs the usageMetadata received up to the abort point.
